content: We attempt to exploit various data augmentation techniques to address the problem of class imbalance. Table TABREF17 shows the results of our experiments for different data augmentation techniques when, after shuffling the training data, we train the model on 75% of the training data and test it on the remaining 25% of the training data and the development data.
